rows.grounds: locative qualifying the circumstance in which expiation is sought
interrogative adverb asking about manner or form
optative expressing what is appropriate or possible
atonement or corrective rite for transgression
imperative request addressed to the speaker's interlocutor
dative pronoun marking the recipient of the instruction

items.question: What form of expiation is appropriate in circumstances of various kinds?
premises: Circumstances requiring expiation can be of various kinds.
The appropriate expiation may depend on the nature of the circumstance.
Authoritative instruction is sought regarding the proper form of expiation.
items.inference: Because circumstances vary, the proper expiation must be specified according to those differing conditions.
uncertainties: The specific kinds of circumstances implied by nānāvidhe are not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Tell me, how indeed should expiation be performed in various kinds of cases?
